plan: The audit will read the supplied measurements and derive the sampling interval from the observed time values, retaining the data dictionary’s seconds unit. It will distinguish temporal sample count from independent physical realizations. For the source normalization, doubling width halves `width[1] / width`; it does not double it. Finite-record log-log slopes will be reported only as descriptive fits over explicit time windows, not as evidence of a universal asymptotic exponent. The output records a judgment, corrected values, and hypothesis implications for each memo item in `audit.json`. The script also prints the key calculated evidence.
term_out: Execution time: a moment seconds (time limit is 2 minutes).
